Finite checks support, do not replace, the symbolic proof.

value.rationale: The result is an exact all-length structural identity for every binary palindrome, reducing the full distinct-subsequence length profile to the pair of half-word ending-letter generating polynomials and one fixed adjoint form. It is not a narrow finite table or the previously known t=1 specialization, and can support graded constrained-language comparisons and reconstruction questions.
